svg.title: The shape of Timesifier
svg.desc: One bench seen from above and to one side, with a machine for each part of the system. A browser's request runs on a rail into the Worker, the large machine at the back corner; the request that sends a sign-in code takes a siding through the Turnstile gate. From the Worker one rail reaches a tray of static assets, the D1 database drum and the email chute, and a conveyor from GitHub Actions carries each build into the Worker.
